# TLDReview adapter

Store Pulse uses the evidence extraction ideas from
[dryden/TLDReview](https://github.com/dryden/TLDReview) at commit
`e7f99abc793f87cb872abf716e45541b620535e0`.

The integration keeps only the review retrieval and normalization boundary. The
vault, OCR, MCP server, and prompt-specific features remain outside this service.
The upstream project is MIT licensed; the original notice is retained below.
